step-1.text: Stand one side panel up, holes facing in. Screw a cam pin into each of the four holes near the top and bottom.

count-1.text: This step uses 1 side panel and 4 cam pins.

step-2.text: Slide the bottom panel onto the pins. Drop two cam locks into the round holes, arrows pointing at the pins, and turn them clockwise until they bite.

count-2.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-3.text: Tap two dowels into the middle of the bottom panel. Press the short divider down onto them, then tap two more dowels into its top.

count-3.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-4.text: Tap two dowels into the side panel at middle height. Lower the long shelf onto the dowels and the divider.

count-4.text: This step uses 1 middle shelf and 2 wood dowels.

step-5.text: Same trick again. Two dowels into the shelf, press on the second divider, two dowels into its top.

count-5.text: This step uses 1 divider and 4 wood dowels.

step-6.text: Set the top panel on the pins and dowels. Two more cam locks, arrows toward the pins, a firm clockwise turn.

count-6.text: This step uses 1 end panel and 2 cam locks.

step-7.text: Screw four cam pins and two dowels into the second side. With a helper, press it onto the open ends, then lock the last four cam locks.

count-7.text: This step uses 1 side panel, 4 cam pins, 2 wood dowels and 4 cam locks.

step-8.text: Screw the wall bracket to the top at the back, then fix it to the wall with screws that suit your wall. Furniture can tip over. Always anchor it.

done.text: Four cubes, zero wobble. Nice work. Time to fill it.
